_comment: Generated by the Phase 1 survey of distinct payload.delivery_state values on build.shipped over 90 days (813 rows, 2026-07-28). The recap renderer may ONLY use a phrase that appears HERE — never a code default, never the event type, never verification_proof/merged, never prose in payload.note. Non-final states are locked phrase:null and a CI check enforces it. Adding or re-phrasing a state is a reviewed one-line PR to this file.

_survey.note: 635 rows (78%) carry NO delivery_state at all — those are Shape B (log-event CLI) payloads whose state exists only as prose inside payload.note. Prose is not machine-readable, so Shape B rows render NOTHING. That is an honest omission, not a bug.

states.why: A pull request is not production. Locked null.
Merged to main is not deployed to production. Locked null.
Explicit verified production deploy. The only other source of a 'live' verb is a verbatim source value.
Explicit verified production ship. Same phrase as deployed.
